in_sanskrit.name: Mijanur
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mijanur एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mijanur is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Maha Janu', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is associated with immense power, wisdom, and divinity. Mijanur is believed to be a powerful protector and a giver of blessings.
